The roof/section expression is too arbitrary and sculptural relative to the brief, and the central opening feels more like a carved atrium than an internally legible sports hall condition. That makes program fit fail the hard gate even though the form is not fragmented. The references suggest a calmer long-span datum with a clearer entry/void hierarchy and less aggressive roof distortion.
